opportunities.name: Brush Health Ap Zone
opportunities.objective: Compare brush and non-brush E damage and lifetime.
opportunities.mechanic: E brush saplings double documented base/AP/health damage and gain health-scaled duration plus AP/health slow. Earned Heartsteel health and Riftmaker conversion can support E while Blackfire tests two-second damage persistence; Q/W maintain access for a follow-up.
opportunities.requiredState: Place E in brush with finite earned health and champion contact.
opportunities.failure: Enemies avoid brush or AP/health investment weakens front-line resists.
opportunities.test: Compare brush and non-brush E damage and lifetime; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A sapling is not given Maokai personal attack on-hit effects.

opportunities.name: Sap Countercast Cycle
opportunities.objective: Count P heals under controlled incoming spell cadence.
opportunities.mechanic: P heals from max health on the next attack and cooldown falls four seconds on ability use or enemy champion ability hits. E champion hit reduces it another four seconds; haste/resists permit real casts and Unending Despair adds close-range recovery. Iceborn gives one actual attack slow after W.
opportunities.requiredState: Keep enemy spell pressure and actual attacks reachable, record P readiness.
opportunities.failure: Cannot attack to collect healing or mana is depleted despite haste.
opportunities.test: Count P heals under controlled incoming spell cadence; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Being hit reduces P cooldown but does not itself perform the healing attack.

ruledOut.reason: P heal is a max-health attack-triggered effect; E is AP/health magic with no ordinary lifesteal statement.

unknowns: P summary mentions extra damage absent from its resolved tooltip; E health statFormula basis and Iceborn interaction require checks.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

builds.name: Brush Health Ap Zone
builds.summary: Compare brush and non-brush E damage and lifetime.
builds.goal: Compare brush and non-brush E damage and lifetime.
builds.hypothesis: E brush saplings double documented base/AP/health damage and gain health-scaled duration plus AP/health slow. Earned Heartsteel health and Riftmaker conversion can support E while Blackfire tests two-second damage persistence; Q/W maintain access for a follow-up.
testPlan: Required state: Place E in brush with finite earned health and champion contact.
Compare brush and non-brush E damage and lifetime; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Enemies avoid brush or AP/health investment weakens front-line resists.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A sapling is not given Maokai personal attack on-hit effects.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Heartsteel, Riftmaker, Blackfire Torch, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Maokai smashes his fist into the ground, dealing [75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.5) × AP] plus [(0.02 / 0.025 / 0.03 / 0.035 / 0.04) × 100]% max Health magic damage and briefly Slowing. Nearby enemies are also Knocked Back.

Maokai transforms into a moving mass of roots, becoming Untargetable and dashing to an enemy. Upon arrival, he Roots the enemy for [1 / 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4] second(s) and deals [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for [30] seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.25) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by [45]% for [2] seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster.

If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for [30 + (0.015) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.5) × AP + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage over [2] seconds and Slowing enemies by [0.45 + (0.0001) × AP + ((0.01) × (0.01)) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]].
